title: chore(examples): let one example app boot under a walled posture — declare @objectstack/organizations (loaded only when OS_TENANCY_POSTURE is group or isolated), so a walled os serve can be measured without a temporary edit
body:
Filing gate **③**: an observation reported by three epic dev sessions (#25271, #24446 U1, #24446 U2). The maintainer asked why the example apps need the package; the answer is in this card.
- **Who acts:** the shared queue.
- **Dedupe:** none.

## What is on `main`
- `@objectstack/organizations` is the multi-organization runtime: the `organization_id` auto-stamp, per-organization seed replay, and the `org-scoping` service SecurityPlugin probes.
  - `os serve` loads it only when the posture is walled (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, `multiTenant = tenancyPosture !== 'single'`).
  - Under a walled posture without it, the boot refuses (unless `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY`).
  - Under `single`, the default, it is never loaded.
- It is app-declared on purpose (ADR-0132 D3, one name and two packages): the framework publishes the Apache-2.0 build, a commercial deployment resolves the same name to its own build, and the host manifest decides which.
- No app under `examples/` declares it. So every walled R4 measurement (a production `os serve` under `isolated` and `group`) has had to add it temporarily and restore it after.
- U2's R4 also had to set, temporarily:
  - a membership policy (`OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`);
  - an `OS_SECRET_KEY`;
  - for a self-registering tenant, an audience posture with its self-registration set.

## Wanted
- Pick one, after measuring:
  - (a) one example (the showcase, say) declares the open build, so `single` is unaffected because it is never loaded there; or
  - (b) a dedicated walled fixture under `packages/qa/dogfood` that declares it.
- Document the walled `os serve` recipe next to it: the env a walled production boot needs.

## Acceptance
- A walled production `os serve` of the chosen app or fixture boots under `isolated` and `group` with no temporary edit, pinned or scripted.
- `single` boots of every example are unchanged.
